baseline.label: V5 · Current baseline
baseline.note: Sticky track and boundary clamping without layout hints. Smoother desktop motion with remaining touch settling steps.

native.label: V7 · Native-flow control
native.note: Fixed-width cards in normal flow for touch, trackpad, and scroll-wheel input. Desktop scroll-wheel settling still steps.

rounded.label: V8 · Whole-pixel settling
rounded.note: Whole-pixel positions during custom settling. Smooth mouse-release settling in the latest desktop test.

touch-handoff.label: V9 · Custom touch settling
touch-handoff.note: Native dragging followed by fractional custom settling. Smoother initial motion with late corrections and boundary overscroll.

original.label: V1 · Original native scrolling
original.note: Queued geometry updates from native scroll events. Stutter on desktop and iOS.

first-token.label: V2 · MD3-timed settling
first-token.note: MD3-timed settling with native scroll writes on each frame. Remaining roughness during settling.

handoff.label: V3 · Synchronized visual settling
handoff.note: Fractional settling and artwork offsets with native synchronization at completion. Smoother desktop motion with remaining touch jitter and stutter.

isolation.label: V4 · Boundary clamping
isolation.note: Boundary clamping with layout containment and compositor hints. Reduced directional jitter with remaining settling stutter.

diagnostic.label: V6 · Fixed masks
diagnostic.note: Fixed mask widths and artwork offsets with scroll-driven positions. Remaining stutter, gaps, and overlaps.
